content.short: Nexus is a platform for volunteers who want to help the Cardano ecosystem in any way they can.
content.description: Nexus is aimed primarily at non-IT people who want to devote a short time to helping Cardano. However, the platform is open to IT gurus and devs from the ecosystem. They can choose one of the roles, for example, Content Creator, Community Noter, RealFi Evangelist, etc., and do a small piece of work for the ecosystem. It works on a volunteer basis. No one receives a financial reward. Volunteers will be featured on Nexus pages and will be able to interact with others on Discord.
